policy.description: Reference-only policy guidance for point accumulation, refunds, expiration, and usage rules.

membership-level-and-cumulative-standard.title: Membership level and cumulative standard information

items.membership-level-and-cumulative-standard: The cumulative amount applies equally to printed products and design products.
Membership is operated based on the 4 quarters of the year (January to March / April to June / July to September / October to December).
It is accumulated for the quarter based on the order date. (Example: Order on September 30th -> Even if it is received on October 1st, it is accumulated for 3 quarters.)
The upgrade date is the first day of each quarter.
The level is maintained regardless of the order amount during the upgraded quarter.
If the cumulative amount for the next quarter falls below the existing level maintenance standard, the level will be downgraded from the following quarter.

items.calculation-of-cumulative-amount-1: The cumulative amount for printed products = Supply price + Tax - Discount + Shipping fee.
items.calculation-of-cumulative-amount-2: The cumulative amount for design products = Supply price + Tax - Discount.
items.calculation-of-cumulative-amount-3: The cumulative amount applies to all payment methods.

items.point-accumulation-information-1: Point accumulation is only possible when paying with a virtual account.
items.point-accumulation-information-2: Points are accumulated based on the payment amount including VAT. (Example: Gold Member) 10,000 won payment -> 2% accumulation = 200 points)
items.point-accumulation-information-3: Points are accumulated after shipment is completed.
items.point-accumulation-information-4: Points are re-accumulated for the payment amount excluding shipping costs and point usage amount.
items.point-accumulation-information-5: Points cannot be refunded. However, if an order using points is refunded, the used points will be restored.

items.point-usage-guide-1: Points can be used in units of 100 points.
items.point-usage-guide-2: Points cannot be used to pay for shipping costs.
items.point-usage-guide-3: Tax invoices cannot be issued for amounts paid with points.
items.point-usage-guide-4: Unused points will automatically expire every 12 months.
items.point-usage-guide-5: Points and membership levels will automatically expire when you cancel your membership.
items.point-usage-guide-6: Points cannot be converted to cash.

items.other-notes-1: Point and membership policies may change according to company policy without prior notice.

remarks.accumulated_after_completed_shipment: Accumulated after completed shipment via virtual account payment.
